```{r}
vars_to_numeric <- c(
  "PSA at diagnosis",

  "Number of fractions", "Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure",
  "Total follow up from recurrence dateto last Fup(m)",             
 "Time from recurrence date to follow up or failure (m)",
 "Total Fup time from reirradiation completion to last Fup", "Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure"
)

# Only convert variables that actually exist in the current dataframe
existing_vars2 <- vars_to_numeric[vars_to_numeric %in% names(reirr)]

# Track the number of new NAs introduced for each variable
na_summary <- list()

for(var in existing_vars2) {
  original_nas <- sum(is.na(reirr[[var]]))
  reirr[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(reirr[[var]]))
  new_nas <- sum(is.na(reirr[[var]]))
  na_summary[[var]] <- new_nas - original_nas
}

# View summary of NAs introduced
print(na_summary)
```

```{r}
# Compute summary statistics for radical phase of patients journey ############
# Compute summary statistics for numeric variables

reirr$`age at diagnosis` <- as.numeric(reirr$`age at diagnosis`)

age <- reirr$`age at diagnosis`
age_n <- sum(!is.na(age))
age_na <- sum(is.na(age))
age_med <- median(age, na.rm = TRUE)
age_q1 <- quantile(age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
age_q3 <- quantile(age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

psa <- reirr$`PSA at diagnosis`
psa_n <- sum(!is.na(psa))
psa_na <- sum(is.na(psa))
psa_med <- median(psa, na.rm = TRUE)
psa_q1 <- quantile(psa, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
psa_q3 <- quantile(psa, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)


# Categorical/frequency tables with updated names
gleason_tab <- table(reirr$`Gleason at diagnosis`, useNA = "ifany")
T_tab <- table(reirr$`T at diagnosis`, useNA = "ifany")
N_tab <- table(reirr$`N at diagnosis`, useNA = "ifany")
M_tab <- table(reirr$`M at diagnosis`, useNA = "ifany")
adt_tab <- table(reirr$`ADT with 1st radical treatment? (Y/N)`, useNA = "ifany")
mod_tab <- table(reirr$`1st treatment modality`, useNA = "ifany")
dose_tab <- table(reirr$`Total dose (Gy)`, useNA = "ifany")
frac_tab <- table(reirr$`Number of fractions`, useNA = "ifany")

# Function to convert tables to dataframe
counts_to_df <- function(tab, varname) {
  data.frame(
    variable = varname,
    value = as.character(names(tab)),
    count = as.integer(tab),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Collate into long data.frame for flextable, with correct variable names
summary_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(variable="PSA at diagnosis", value=c("n","n_missing","median (Q1, Q3)"),
             count=c(psa_n, psa_na, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", psa_med, psa_q1, psa_q3))),
  data.frame(variable="Age at diagnosis", value=c("n","n_missing","median (Q1, Q3)"), 
             count=c(age_n, age_na, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", age_med, age_q1, age_q3))),
  counts_to_df(gleason_tab, "Gleason at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(T_tab, "T at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(N_tab, "N at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(M_tab, "M at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(adt_tab, "ADT with 1st radical treatment? (Y/N)"),
  counts_to_df(mod_tab, "1st treatment modality"),
  counts_to_df(dose_tab, "Total dose (Gy)"),
  counts_to_df(frac_tab, "Number of fractions")
)

# Missing counts for categorical variables
gleason_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`Gleason at diagnosis`))
T_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`T at diagnosis`))
N_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`N at diagnosis`))
M_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`M at diagnosis`))
adt_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`ADT with 1st radical treatment? (Y/N)`))

# Add to summary table for missingness
missing_df <- data.frame(
  variable = c("Gleason at diagnosis", "T at diagnosis", "N at diagnosis", "M at diagnosis", "ADT with 1st radical treatment? (Y/N)"),
  value    = rep("n_missing", 5),
  count    = c(gleason_na, T_na, N_na, M_na, adt_na)
)

# Combine with previous summary_df
summary_df <- rbind(
  data.frame(variable="PSA at diagnosis", value=c("n","n_missing","median (Q1, Q3)"),
             count=c(psa_n, psa_na, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", psa_med, psa_q1, psa_q3))),
  data.frame(variable="Age at diagnosis", value=c("n","n_missing","median (Q1, Q3)"), 
             count=c(age_n, age_na, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", age_med, age_q1, age_q3))),
  missing_df,
  counts_to_df(gleason_tab, "Gleason at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(T_tab, "T at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(N_tab, "N at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(M_tab, "M at diagnosis"),
  counts_to_df(adt_tab, "ADT with 1st radical treatment? (Y/N)"),
  counts_to_df(mod_tab, "1st treatment modality"),
  counts_to_df(dose_tab, "Total dose (Gy)"),
  counts_to_df(frac_tab, "Number of fractions")
)


# Create flextable
Reirr_summ_initial <- flextable::flextable(summary_df)
Reirr_summ_initial <- flextable::autofit(Reirr_summ_initial)

# Export to Word file
doc <- officer::read_docx()
doc <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc, Reirr_summ_initial)
print(doc, target = "C:/Sian Hard drive/RMH/Chapter 7 Reirradiation/R script/October 2025 output/reirr_diagnosticphase_summary.docx")
```

```{r}
# Subset to exclude unwanted modalities
side_table <- dplyr::filter(
  reirr,
  !(`1st treatment modality` %in% c("LDR brachytherapy", "LDR", "HDR brachytherapy", "HDR"))
)

# Create dose/fraction string
side_table$dose_frac <- paste0(
  side_table$`Total dose (Gy)`, "/", side_table$`Number of fractions`
)

# Summarise unique dose/fraction combos by modality
dose_frac_summary <- aggregate(
  dose_frac ~ `1st treatment modality`,
  data = side_table,
  FUN = function(x) paste(unique(na.omit(x)), collapse = ", ")
)

# Count per modality
modality_counts <- as.data.frame(table(side_table$`1st treatment modality`))
names(modality_counts) <- c("1st treatment modality", "Count")

# Count number of NAs for dose or fraction per modality
missing_count <- aggregate(
  is.na(side_table$`Total dose (Gy)`) | is.na(side_table$`Number of fractions`) ~ `1st treatment modality`,
  data = side_table,
  FUN = sum
)
names(missing_count)[2] <- "Missing Count"

# Join everything
side_modality_summary <- modality_counts %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dose_frac_summary, by = "1st treatment modality") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(missing_count, by = "1st treatment modality")

# Make flextable
Side_modality_flextable <- flextable::flextable(side_modality_summary)
Side_modality_flextable <- flextable::autofit(Side_modality_flextable)

# Save to Word
side_table_path <- "C:/Sian Hard drive/RMH/Chapter 7 Reirradiation/R script/October 2025 output/fractionation_modality_table.docx"
doc2 <- officer::read_docx()
doc2 <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc2, Side_modality_flextable)
print(doc2, target = side_table_path)
```

```{r}

### descriptives for median, IQR etc 

get_numeric_stats <- function(x, name) {
  xnum <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  n <- sum(!is.na(xnum))
  nmiss <- sum(is.na(xnum))
  med <- median(xnum, na.rm=TRUE)
  q1 <- quantile(xnum, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(xnum, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE)
  data.frame(
    variable = name,
    value = c("n","n_missing","median (Q1, Q3)"),
    count = c(n, nmiss, sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", med, q1, q3)),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

get_casecount <- function(x, name) {
  # Case-insensitive counts for "Y", "N", NA etc.
  xnorm <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  tbl <- table(xnorm, useNA = "ifany")
  data.frame(
    variable = name,
    value = names(tbl),
    count = as.integer(tbl),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

get_counts <- function(x, name) {
  tbl <- table(x, useNA="ifany")
  data.frame(
    variable = name,
    value = names(tbl),
    count = as.integer(tbl),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Compute missing values count
Trec_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`T at recurrence`))
Nrec_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`N at recurrence`))
Mrec_na <- sum(is.na(reirr$`M at recurrence`))

missing_rec_df <- data.frame(
  variable = c("T at recurrence", "N at recurrence", "M at recurrence"),
  value = rep("n_missing", 3),
  count = c(Trec_na, Nrec_na, Mrec_na),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

summary_rec <- rbind(
  get_numeric_stats(reirr$`ECOG at recurrence`, "ECOG at recurrence"),
  get_numeric_stats(reirr$PSA, "PSA at recurrence"),
  get_casecount(reirr$`Biopsy (Y/N)`, "Biopsy (Y/N)"),
  get_numeric_stats(reirr$`IPSS at recurrence`, "IPSS at recurrence"),
  get_casecount(reirr$`mpMRI (Y/N)`, "mpMRI (Y/N)"),
  get_casecount(reirr$`PET (Y/N)`, "PET (Y/N)"),
  get_counts(reirr$`Location of recurrence`, "Location of recurrence"),
  missing_rec_df,
  get_counts(reirr$`T at recurrence`, "T at recurrence"),
  get_counts(reirr$`N at recurrence`, "N at recurrence"),
  get_counts(reirr$`M at recurrence`, "M at recurrence")
)

# Proceed with flextable as before
Reirr_summ_recurrence <- flextable::flextable(summary_rec)
Reirr_summ_recurrence <- flextable::autofit(Reirr_summ_recurrence)
doc2 <- officer::read_docx()
doc2 <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc2, Reirr_summ_recurrence)

print(doc2, target = "C:/Sian Hard drive/RMH/Chapter 7 Reirradiation/R script/October 2025 output/reirr_recurrence_metrics_summary.docx")
```

```{r}
summarize_text_col <- function(x, varname) {
  x_clean <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  is_na <- is.na(x_clean) | x_clean %in% c('', 'na', 'n/a')
  n <- sum(!is_na)
  n_missing <- sum(is_na)
  tab <- sort(table(factor(x_clean[!is_na]), useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)
  preview <- names(tab)[1:min(5, length(tab))]
  preview_val <- if(length(preview) > 0) paste(preview, collapse="; ") else ""
  data.frame(
    variable = varname,
    value = c("n","n_missing","top_5_unique"),
    count = c(n, n_missing, preview_val),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}
```


```{r}
# Case-insensitive counts for Single and multidose (and missing)
single_multi_counts <- function(x, varname = "Single/multidose prescription?") {
  x_clean <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  n_single <- sum(x_clean == "single", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_multidose <- sum(x_clean == "multidose", na.rm = TRUE)
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(x_clean) | x_clean %in% c('', 'na', 'n/a'))
  data.frame(
    variable = varname,
    value = c("single", "multidose", "n_missing"),
    count = c(n_single, n_multidose, n_missing),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Build summary data.frame for all columns
summary_reirr <- rbind(
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`PTV dose prescription (Gy/#)`, "PTV dose prescription (Gy/#)"),
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`Prescription freetext`, "Prescription freetext"),
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`Freetext how CTV /PTV margins derived`, "CTV/PTV margins derived"),
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`Rectum dose constraints freetext, a/b?`, "Rectum dose constraints"),
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`Urethra dose constraints freetext, a/b?`, "Urethra dose constraints"),
  summarize_text_col(reirr$`Bladder dose constraints freetext, a/b?`, "Bladder dose constraints"),
  single_multi_counts(reirr$`Single/multidose prescription?`)
)

# Create flextable
Reirr_summ_reirradiation <- flextable::flextable(summary_reirr)
Reirr_summ_reirradiation <- flextable::autofit(Reirr_summ_reirradiation)
```

```{r}
### toxicity descriptives

# Helper: tabulate grades (0,1,2,3...) and count missing for a column
summarize_grade_col <- function(x, label) {
  x_clean <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  is_na <- is.na(x_clean) | x_clean %in% c('', 'na', 'n/a')
  tab <- sort(table(factor(x_clean[!is_na], levels=c('0','1','2','3','4','5'))), decreasing = TRUE)
  n <- sum(!is_na)
  n_missing <- sum(is_na)
  # Combine into data.frame
  data.frame(
    timepoint = label,
    grade = c(names(tab), "missing"),
    n = c(as.integer(tab), n_missing),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Apply for 3mo, 6mo, 12mo GU columns
summ_3mo <- summarize_grade_col(reirr$`Worst GU CTCAE 3mo`, "GU_3mo")
summ_6mo <- summarize_grade_col(reirr$`Worst GU CTCAE 6mo`, "GU_6mo")
summ_12mo <- summarize_grade_col(reirr$`Worst GU CTCAE 12mo`, "GU_12mo")

# Combine results
gu_counts_all <- rbind(summ_3mo, summ_6mo, summ_12mo)

# Optional: display as flextable
ft <- flextable::flextable(gu_counts_all)
ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)

# Export to Word if needed
doc <- officer::read_docx()
doc <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc, ft)
print(doc, target = "C:/Sian Hard drive/RMH/Chapter 7 Reirradiation/R script/October 2025 output/gu_grades_by_timepoint.docx")
```

```{r}
# Helper for summarising GI grades at each timepoint
summarize_grade_col <- function(x, label) {
  x_clean <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  is_na <- is.na(x_clean) | x_clean %in% c('', 'na', 'n/a')
  tab <- sort(table(factor(x_clean[!is_na], levels=c('0','1','2','3','4','5'))), decreasing = TRUE)
  n_missing <- sum(is_na)
  data.frame(
    timepoint = label,
    grade = c(names(tab), "missing"),
    n = c(as.integer(tab), n_missing),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
```

```{r}
# For median, Q1, Q3 of follow-up
event_followup_col <- "Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure"
evfollowup <- as.numeric(reirr[[event_followup_col]])
median_fup <- median(evfollowup, na.rm=TRUE)
q1_fup <- quantile(evfollowup, 0.25, na.rm=TRUE)
q3_fup <- quantile(evfollowup, 0.75, na.rm=TRUE)
evfup_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("median", "q1", "q3"),
  months = c(median_fup, q1_fup, q3_fup)
)

followup_col2 <- "Total Fup time from reirradiation completion to last Fup"
followup2 <- as.numeric(reirr[[followup_col2]])
median_fup2 <- median(followup2, na.rm = TRUE)
q1_fup2 <- quantile(followup2, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3_fup2 <- quantile(followup2, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
fup_summary2 <- data.frame(
  metric = c("median", "q1", "q3"),
  months = c(median_fup2, q1_fup2, q3_fup2)
)

relapse_col <- "Relapse time from radical treatment"
relapse_time <- as.numeric(reirr[[relapse_col]])
median_relapse <- median(relapse_time, na.rm = TRUE)
q1_relapse <- quantile(relapse_time, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3_relapse <- quantile(relapse_time, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
relapse_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("median", "q1", "q3"),
  months = c(median_relapse, q1_relapse, q3_relapse)
)

# Helper function to summarize a time metric
summarize_time_metric <- function(vec, label) {
  vec_numeric <- as.numeric(vec)
  n <- sum(!is.na(vec_numeric))
  missing <- sum(is.na(vec_numeric))
  q1 <- quantile(vec_numeric, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  median <- median(vec_numeric, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(vec_numeric, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    timing_event = label,
    n = n,
    missing = missing,
    q1 = q1,
    median = median,
    q3 = q3,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Summarize each metric
summary_evfollowup <- summarize_time_metric(
  reirr$`Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure`,
  "Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure"
)
summary_fup2 <- summarize_time_metric(
  reirr$`Total Fup time from reirradiation completion to last Fup`,
  "Total Fup time from reirradiation completion to last Fup"
)
summary_relapse <- summarize_time_metric(
  reirr$`Relapse time from radical treatment`,
  "Relapse time from radical treatment"
)

# Combine into one table for output
summary_all <- rbind(summary_evfollowup, summary_fup2, summary_relapse)

# View as flextable
summary_ft <- flextable::flextable(summary_all)

# Export to Word if desired
doc <- officer::read_docx()
doc <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc, summary_ft)
print(doc, target="C:/Sian Hard drive/RMH/Chapter 7 Reirradiation/R script/October 2025 output/Time to event summaries improved.docx")
```

```{r}
#KM time to recurrence

# Rename for clarity (if needed, or directly use correct column names)
df <- reirr

# Clean event variable: code as 1 if Recurrence event == 1, 0 otherwise
df$recurrence_event <- as.numeric(trimws(df$`Recurrence event`)) == 1
df$time_fup_or_failure <- as.numeric(df$`Time from reirradiation completion to last follow up or failure`)

# Create survival object
surv_obj <- survival::Surv(time = df$time_fup_or_failure, event = df$recurrence_event)

# Fit Kaplan-Meier
km_fit <- survival::survfit(surv_obj ~ 1, data = df)

km_plot <- survminer::ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data = df,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time (months)",
  ylab = "Recurrence-free Survival Probability",
  title = "Time to recurrence (KM method)",
  palette = "#00008B",
  ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black"),
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank()
    ),
  risk.table.height = 0.25,
  tables.theme = survminer::theme_cleantable(),
  legend = "none" # add this to remove legend
)
print(km_plot)


```

print(km_plot, newpage = TRUE)
